summary: Iteration 4 — Frontend regression for АвтоРесурс /auto module after AutoHome redesign + chat FAB z-index fix. All P0 flows PASS: homepage redesign (ContactsBar with 3 phones, АВТОРЕСУРС brand, sticky nav with renamed 'Списанные авто', QCS); Russian AI ChatWidget end-to-end (FAB visible, panel opens, Тина greeting, sent 'Сколько стоит депозит?' → AI replied in Russian with NZ$1,000); localStorage persistence + Очистить both work; all 6 nav routes load without errors; /api/auto/catalog-summary feeds QCS counts and SearchHero 'Найти (31)' button; login + /auto/dashboard works for verified customer. One minor i18n inconsistency found in QuickCategoryStrip.

issues: QCS still labels the 'End of Life' tile in English while every other tile is in Russian (Аукционы, Купить сейчас, Повреждённые, Календарь, Мотоциклы, Лодки и катера, Грузовики, Автодома, Запчасти). The top nav was correctly renamed to 'Списанные авто', but QuickCategoryStrip wasn't. Recommend updating the QCS tile to 'Списанные авто' (or 'Списанные') for i18n consistency.

action_items: Low-priority: rename QCS tile 'End of Life' → 'Списанные авто' in /app/frontend/src/components/auto/QuickCategoryStrip.jsx so the whole strip is in Russian.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatWidget.jsx: localStorage key 'avtoresurs_chat_history' is shared across all users on the same browser — when a user logs out and another logs in, they'll see previous chat. Acceptable for an anonymous assistant, but worth namespacing by user.id if user is logged in.
ChatWidget.jsx error fallback catches every axios error with the same Russian text — consider surfacing 429/5xx differently so user knows it's rate-limit vs server fault.
AutoLayout.jsx 'nav-login' and 'nav-register' both link to '/' (same target); ideally 'Зарегистрироваться' should open a registration form/route, not the home page.
auto_routes.py was 1090+ lines last iteration — still over the 700-line guideline; please split as recommended in iter3 report.
test_credentials: admin@buyanywhere.com / admin12345 ; client@buyanywhere.com / client12345 — both verified to work via POST /api/auth/login
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage 'avtoresurs_chat_history' during chat tests; otherwise no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI smoke flows for /auto module are green. Chat FAB bbox at 1920x4000 viewport = x≈1721, y≈3856 (lower-right, not behind Emergent badge — fix from iter3 verified). When testing login programmatically, set THREE localStorage keys (token, access_token, buyanywhere_token) because AuthContext source key wasn't audited here. AI chat answers in clean Russian and quotes NZ$1,000 deposit correctly — Emergent LLM integration is healthy. Two transient 500 responses were seen on first load of /auto/dashboard but did not block render and were not reproducible on retry (likely /api/auth/me probe race with multiple token keys).
